name: Path Feature
summary: Warlock Path Feature Seer of Battle Your d4 becomes a d6 for your Warlock Path feature. Storm Warlock Once per turn, when a psychic power damages a creature, push it 5 ft. Warlock Path Feature Spirit Guardian When you reduce damage with Rune Ward, the target also gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.
